# Medical Guidebook
## Order of Care
1. Select a body region on the targeting doll. 2. Stop external bleeding. 3. Check oxygen, circulating blood, perfusion, and heart rhythm. 4. Perform a handheld analysis or a full scan. 5. Stabilize breathing and circulation. 6. Treat wounds and splint fractures. 7. Perform the required surgery. 8. Re-scan.
## Core Items
- [color=#58e6d9]HandheldHealthAnalyzer[/color] — approximate diagnostics for vital signs and external injuries. - [color=#58e6d9]MedicalScanner + computerBodyScanner[/color] — full list of wounds, organs, fractures, drugs, and cyberware. - [color=#58e6d9]Gauze[/color] — bandage for external capillary and venous bleeding. - [color=#58e6d9]Brutepack[/color] — hemostatic pack for a deep external wound. - [color=#58e6d9]Tourniquet[/color] — blocks external bleeding on a limb. - [color=#58e6d9]NCFieldSplint[/color] — limb fracture stabilization. - [color=#58e6d9]NCManualVentilator[/color] — temporary artificial ventilation. - [color=#58e6d9]Bloodpack[/color] — restores blood in the bloodstream. - [color=#58e6d9]Defibrillator[/color] — restores a shockable cardiac rhythm.
